title: Mughisuddin Tughral
note: Banglapedia biography by ABM Shamsuddin Ahmed on Balban's later deputy and rebel, distinct from the earlier governor Tughral Tughan Khan. Its narrative is a modern reference synthesis and contains territorial interpretations not established by the contemporary chronicle alone.
whyItMatters: It describes the later Tughral's appointment under Amin Khan, revolt against Balban, the Sultan's 1280 campaign, and Bughra Khan's installation, while its differing 1277 and 1281 dates expose chronology that must be attributed rather than flattened.
